brief:
Israeli forces shot and wounded a Palestinian citizen in Khan Younis on Wednesday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The shooting took place as multiple locations across Gaza Strip faced sustained artillery bombardment and gunfire from Israeli military vehicles and naval vessels operating in coastal waters.

The incident marks another breach of the ceasefire agreement governing military conduct in the territory. Shelling and live fire strikes have continued across dispersed areas of the enclave throughout the period under question, according to reports from the agency.
